readme:
# Seedream 5.0 Lite Text to Image

Seedream 5.0 Lite: the lightweight Seedream 5.0 tier, with good quality at lower latency and cost.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 50,000 characters. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `3:2` / `4:3` / `5:4` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `3:4` / `2:3` / `9:16` | `1:1` | Output shape. |
| `output_format` | `jpeg` / `png` | `png` | Output file format. |

## Billing

$0.035 per image.

| Request | Price |
|---|---|
| One image | $0.035 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Write subject, layout, style, then light and color.
- Quote any text that must appear.

## Limits

- One output image per request.

## Also on SandBase

Other Seedream endpoints: `bytedance/seedream/5.0/pro`, `bytedance/seedream/5.0/pro/edit`, `bytedance/seedream/5.0/lite/edit`, `bytedance/seedream/5.0/flash`, `bytedance/seedream/5.0/flash/edit`, `bytedance/seedream/4.5`, `bytedance/seedream/4.5/edit`.
